output.reason: [ev-274ce3859ab9] says the `istiod-remote` chart was removed in favor of `helm install istio-discovery --set profile=remote`. [ev-5a31c0781dc5] adds that the chart was merged into the regular istio-discovery chart, and it gives the old install command and its replacement. Users of the removed chart therefore have to move to the remote profile. No subject family covers a whole Helm chart, so a helm-value subject (as in P2) would be wrong. The migration family with migration-required, using a name built from the evidence's own key words, fits this best.
